integrity-protocol.reason: Both migrations went through the sanctioned path only. 065 was applied to a scratch copy and to a full rebuild from migration history BEFORE canonical, and compared structurally under a declared fold map; the data migration was dry-run on a scratch copy (184 decisions, 540 links, foreign_key_check clean) before scripts/migrate_db.py touched canonical. No hand-written SQL was executed against data/guidebook.db.

source-discipline.reason: Every figure in the record is a measurement taken this session against the live database, and the record states what was GIVEN UP alongside what was gained: uniqueness is weaker, applicability became nullable, and the graph extractor still draws only one of the four lenses. Three items the session chose not to fix are listed as owed rather than omitted. The four advisory check failures are reported with the measurement that shows they are pre-existing -- identical counts on origin/main -- rather than asserted to be someone else's.

adherence-logging-and-attestation.reason: One attestation per record, alongside the three covering this session's DRs. attestation_presence requires one per record; a single attestation covering the batch fails it.

deviations: Migration 065 was EDITED rather than fixed forward. It had been committed on 2026-09-01 under a different name and a narrower purpose. CLAUDE.md rule 3 makes migrations immutable once committed; the reasoning for editing rather than compensating is stated in the migration's own header -- it had never been applied (PRAGMA user_version was 64 and schema migrations leave no ledger row), so no database existed that it could diverge from, and fixing forward would have meant landing a shape this session already knew was wrong and then rebuilding to correct it. Rebuilding the table twice is the double-sweep CLAUDE.md §0.4 describes.
bias_direction: Toward presenting a restructuring the session designed as settled and mechanical. Resisted in three places: the two capabilities given up are named in the record, in the decision's notes and in the migration header rather than left to be discovered; the ICF-lens graph coverage was recorded as owed rather than fixed inside a rename sweep where its effect on audit output would not have been examined; and D-0184 is recorded DG-REVIEW with review_status PENDING rather than DG-AUTO, because it fixes the shape the render layer will be built against.
independent_reviewer_counterclaim: That a read-only investigation was allowed to turn into a landed schema change within one session, so the finding and the act on it were never separated for review. Sustained in part and mitigated rather than rebutted: the investigation's conclusion is committed on its own (803de13) BEFORE anything was written, so the reasoning can be read without the migration, and the decision that acts on it carries review_status PENDING.
